name: SAP BW/4HANA
certifications: SAP Certified Associate - Reporting, Modeling and Data Acquisition with SAP BW/4HANA (C_BW4H)
SAP Certified Associate - Data Engineer - SAP Datasphere

beginner.summary: For BI developers, report authors and new BW consultants with no BW/4HANA experience. Covers data warehousing on SAP HANA, the modelling tools and cockpit, InfoObjects and master data, source systems and extraction from S/4HANA, flat files, DataStore objects, transformations, data transfer processes, process chains, CompositeProviders and Open ODS views, queries, reporting in Analysis for Office and SAP Analytics Cloud, analysis authorisations and load monitoring.
prerequisites: Knows basic SQL and reporting ideas: tables, joins, measures and dimensions
Understands business data such as sales orders, invoices and stock
Access to an SAP BW/4HANA training system
outcomes: Model InfoObjects, DataStore objects and CompositeProviders
Load data from S/4HANA and flat files with transformations and DTPs
Schedule and monitor loads with process chains
Build queries and reports with analysis authorisations

intermediate.summary: For BW developers and consultants who can build a data mart. prerequisites: Can build a BW/4HANA data flow from source to query
Knows DataStore objects, transformations, DTPs and process chains
Can write basic SQL and read ABAP
outcomes: Design layered BW/4HANA architectures and data models
Build complex transformations, mixed models and queries
Run planning, data tiering and real-time loading
Secure, tune, transport and reconcile BW solutions

advanced.summary: For senior BW consultants, data warehouse architects and analytics leads. Covers enterprise data warehouse architecture, SAP Business Data Cloud with BW private cloud edition and data products, the SAP Datasphere BW bridge, conversion from SAP BW 7.x, moving models to SAP Datasphere, performance engineering, data volume strategy, complex modelling patterns, planning at scale, Joule and AI, machine learning on BW data, real-time architecture, security, governance and lineage, DevOps, operations, troubleshooting, analytics operating models and transformation roadmaps.
prerequisites: Has built BW/4HANA or SAP BW data warehouses in a project
Knows delta management, routines, mixed modelling and authorisations
Understands SAP HANA and the SAP analytics portfolio
outcomes: Design data warehouse architectures across BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere and SAP Business Data Cloud
Plan BW conversions and moves to SAP Business Data Cloud
Engineer performance, data volume, security and governance at scale
Lead analytics operating models and transformation programmes
